purpose: Post-run scoring rubric only. It is never loaded by production graph or model prompt.

scoring.citation_identity_valid: Every cited evidence ID is in current run read set and locator/hash resolves.
scoring.semantic_support: Human reviewer marks every verifiable factual claim as supported, partially supported, or unsupported by cited excerpt.
scoring.scope: Candidate IDs, dimensions, source snapshot and hard constraints are preserved.
scoring.gap_handling: Declared unknown pairs are not treated as negative evidence and do not yield unconditional recommendation.
scoring.serious_error: Invented capability, unsupported performance/pricing claim, ignored hard constraint, or version confusion that changes recommendation.
scoring.delivery: Completed reports / all attempted reports; failures, budget stops and rejected reports remain in denominator.

prohibitions: Do not score by matching a fixed recommendation.
Do not edit this rubric after seeing held-out outputs.
Do not feed this file to model or production graph.
